scanner.title: Scanner Input
whereToLook: Make sure you create a Scanner object using System.in before you try to read any input.
Read the three values in the order the prompts ask for them: target speed, rate of increase, then minutes.
Use nextDouble() since each value should be stored as a double.

methods.title: The currentSpeed Method
whereToLook: The method must be named currentSpeed, be static, and return a double.
It should accept three double parameters, in this order: target speed, rate (as a decimal), and minutes.
Call the method from main and pass it the values you read from the astronaut, not literal numbers.

formula.title: The Speed Formula
whereToLook: Use Math.pow(1 + rate, minutes) to raise (1 + rate) to the minutes power.
Divide the entered percent (for example, 5) by 100 to convert it to decimal notation (0.05) before using it in the formula.

formatting.title: Output Formatting
whereToLook: The current speed must be printed with a comma thousands separator and exactly two decimal places.
Look at String.format or printf with a pattern like %,.2f to produce this formatting.
